en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Asadi al-Barda`i narrated to us. He said: Ruqayya bt. Ishaq b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib narrated to us from her father from her forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

No worshiper’s foot will move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about four: (1) his life – how did he spend it? (2) His youth – how did he use it? (3) His wealth – where did he earn it, and how did he spend it? (4) And about loving us, the Ahl al-Bayt.
